posts.t: Justin Danforth and Sam Carrick are being evaluated, Lindy Ruff said. Carrick is dealing with a mid-body injury, “possibly might be related” to last season’s injury.

Jason Zucker is working with the second power play unit at Sabres practice today. 

Justin Danforth and Sam Carrick aren’t on the ice

Good morning from Harborcenter.

Don’t see Sam Carrick. Justin Danforth (upper body) also remains absent.
Sabres captain Rasmus Dahlin has returned to practice. Tyson Kozak is out there as well. No Justin Danforth today.
